content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated pool d-pool-42 in eu-west-2 reporting sustained enqueue latency > 800ms and 5xx retries. Severity: P1. Auto-escalate to oncall.
maria_oncall: Acked. Looking at metrics now — spike in incoming QPS from a handful of API keys.
sam_infra: Confirming. I see a sharp jump starting ~2m ago from customer c-omega doing large batch embedding jobs. KV memory pressure increasing, some worker restarts.
tara_pd: Do we have recent routing fallback enabled? Could route be sending heavy requests to this pool only?
maria_oncall: Routing policy still pointing heavy traffic to d-pool-42 (eu-west-optimized). Also noticed reranking feature flag enabled for that customer — causes large context lengths.
sam_infra: Repro: curl to /v1/embeddings with same payload => pushes concurrency high. Suggest we throttle that customer's key and toggle autoscale burst to prevent OOM cascades.
jamie_oncall: @maria_oncall let's coordinate handoff if you need to step out.
maria_oncall: I'll stay. Jamie — standby for 1st handoff in 20.
ops-bot: Runbook ref: dedicated-pool-surge -> recommended mitigations: 1) set-burst false 2) apply per-customer throttle 3) disable heavy feature flag 4) shift traffic to fallback pools.
sam_infra: Proposed commands:
```
infractl pools update d-pool-42 --autoscale-burst off --note "mitigation: transient surge, temp disable burst"
infractl quotas update --api-key c-omega --rate 50rps --burst 10
routingctl route shift --from d-pool-42 --to d-pool-44 --weight 20%
```
maria_oncall: Doing step 1 now.
maria_oncall: `infractl pools update d-pool-42 --autoscale-burst off --note "mitigation: surge 4123456789"` -> accepted. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Action recorded: autoscale burst toggled OFF for d-pool-42 by maria_oncall.
sam_infra: Applying rate-limit on c-omega.
sam_infra: `infractl quotas update --api-key c-omega --rate 50rps --burst 10 --note "emergency throttle"` -> applied. Will take ~30s to propagate.
tara_pd: Heads-up: this will cause 429s for long-running customers; need to notify CS if degraded.
maria_oncall: Starting graceful traffic shift 10% to d-pool-44 as buffer.
ops-bot: Routing change initiated. Expect partial relief in ~45s.
jamie_oncall: Taking over the thread for next 30m. Maria — thanks, wonderful handoff. I have console access for logs if needed.
maria_oncall: Thanks — handing off. Key notes: burst OFF, c-omega throttled to 50rps, reranking feature flag predicted hot-path; if issues persist, flip rerank off for c-omega.
jamie_oncall: Acknowledged. I'll watch the queue depth graphs and CPU/GPU memory. If memory continues rising, we'll disable rerank and expand fallback pool weight to 50%.
ops-bot: Metric alert: queue_latency_p50 for d-pool-42 dropped from 820ms -> 420ms after toggles. Retries trending down. :thumbsup:
tara_pd: Customer impact: c-omega showing increased 429s (~18%) but still processing most jobs — CS notified to expect partial failures.
sam_infra: If we re-enable burst later, prefer gradual roll (10% increments) and monitor memory.
jamie_oncall: For postmortem: collect allocation traces, kernel OOM logs, and the exact payloads for top 5 offending API keys. Also review autoscale-burst heuristic.
maria_oncall: Filing incident ticket and tagging the customer impact section.
incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigated -> partial: heavy traffic contained; follow-up tasks created.
jamie_oncall: I'll keep watch for 30m then publish short summary and next steps. If any regression, ping me directly. :phone:
ops-bot: Reminder: update runbook if autoscale-burst toggles are now sensitive under combined rerank+batching workloads.
maria_oncall: Noted. I'll add a short note in runbook after shift. Good job team.
